sources.title: syntheticbot/ocr-qwen · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🤖 ModelScope For users in mainland China, ModelScope is recommended. Use snapshot_download for checkpoint management. Adapt model names to syntheticbot/ocr-qwen in ModelScope implementations. More Usage Tips for OCR Input images support local files, URLs, and base64 encoding.
